transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi — I have a question. I’m in a rented apartment. Can you still take up a project?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It depends on the scope. What are you looking to do?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: It’s a 2BHK in Baner. I’ve been here a year, I have a 3-year lease, and the place is quite bare. I want to properly design the living room, bedroom, and kitchen — no structural changes, just design and fittings.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That’s fine — we’ve done rented apartments before. For the kitchen we’d do a modular unit that can come out cleanly. The rest is largely flooring, lighting, and furniture — all reversible. Have you checked with your landlord?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes — they’re fine with it as long as we don’t break walls.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect. No wall-breaking from us. Shall we set up a consultation?
